opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish higher education institution, and not eligible for government funding for their tuition fees. Must be entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, have Limited Leave to Remain, or be an asylum seeker.
opportunities.summary: Grants covering the cost of tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for undergraduate students from low-income households in Scotland who are ineligible for government tuition fee support, including those reskilling via a second degree in skills-shortage subject areas.
